domain_restrictions: F_n is defined for all real inputs, including x plus z

x must be a real number
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For each fixed value of n as intended, for all integers z and all real numbers x, F_n evaluated at x plus z equals F_n evaluated at x.
quantifier_order: for all x in real numbers

variables.name: z
variables.role: shift amount in an additive translation

variables.name: n
variables.role: index of the function F_n; appears free

statement_nl: For every integer z and every real x, F_n(x+z) = F_n(x).
